text.en: Describe your ideal weekday routine.
text.zh: 请描述你理想中的平日作息。

text.en: What is one small habit that improves your day?
text.zh: 哪一个小习惯能让你的一天过得更好？

text.en: How do you usually relax after work or school?
text.zh: 工作或上学后，你通常怎样放松？

text.en: What chore do you dislike the most and why?
text.zh: 你最不喜欢哪一项家务？为什么？

text.en: What is your favorite part of the day?
text.zh: 一天里你最喜欢哪个时段？

text.en: How do you stay organized during a busy week?
text.zh: 忙碌的一周里，你怎样让自己保持有条理？

text.en: What is something simple you enjoy doing alone?
text.zh: 有什么简单的小事是你喜欢一个人做的？

text.en: Describe a daily routine from your childhood.
text.zh: 请描述你小时候的一项日常习惯。

text.en: What is one thing you always carry with you?
text.zh: 有什么东西是你总会随身带着的？

text.en: How has your morning routine changed over time?
text.zh: 这些年来，你的晨间习惯有什么变化？

text.en: What is a small convenience you are thankful for?
text.zh: 有什么小小的便利让你很感激？

text.en: When do you feel most productive?
text.zh: 你什么时候觉得自己效率最高？

text.en: What everyday task do you do faster than most people?
text.zh: 有什么日常事情是你做得比大多数人更快的？

text.en: What lesson from a family member still guides you today?
text.zh: 哪一条来自家人的教导，至今仍在指引你？

text.en: Describe a family tradition you enjoy.
text.zh: 请分享一项你喜欢的家庭传统。

text.en: Who in your family makes everyone laugh?
text.zh: 你家里是谁最会逗大家开心？

text.en: What is a memorable family celebration you attended?
text.zh: 你参加过哪一次难忘的家庭庆祝活动？

text.en: What role do you usually play during family gatherings?
text.zh: 在家庭聚会中，你通常扮演什么角色？

text.en: What is something you appreciate more about family as you get older?
text.zh: 随着年龄增长，你更珍惜家庭的什么？

text.en: Share a story about a family trip or outing.
text.zh: 请分享一次家庭旅行或出游的故事。

text.en: What is a family recipe or food you care about?
text.zh: 你很在意的一道家庭食谱或食物是什么？

text.en: What family habit would you like to pass on?
text.zh: 你想把哪一个家庭习惯传承下去？

text.en: Describe a time your family supported you.
text.zh: 请描述一次家人支持你的经历。

text.en: What is one value your family emphasized?
text.zh: 你的家庭特别重视哪一种价值观？

text.en: Who is someone in your family you admire and why?
text.zh: 你家里有谁是你敬佩的？为什么？

text.en: What makes a family gathering enjoyable for you?
text.zh: 什么会让你觉得家庭聚会很愉快？

text.en: Describe a trip that surprised you in a good way.
text.zh: 请描述一次让你惊喜连连的旅行。

text.en: What destination is on your wish list and why?
text.zh: 你的愿望清单上有哪些目的地？为什么？

text.en: Tell us about a time you got lost while traveling.
text.zh: 请说说你旅行时迷路的一次经历。

text.en: What do you always pack, no matter where you go?
text.zh: 不管去哪里旅行，你一定会带什么？

text.en: Do you prefer detailed plans or flexible travel? Why?
text.zh: 你更喜欢详细规划还是灵活旅行？为什么？

text.en: What is the most beautiful place you have visited?
text.zh: 你去过最美的地方是哪里？

text.en: Describe a travel experience that taught you something.
text.zh: 请描述一次让你学到东西的旅行经历。

text.en: What kind of travel do you enjoy most: city, nature, or beach?
text.zh: 你最喜欢哪种旅行：城市、自然还是海边？

text.en: What is one place you would revisit immediately?
text.zh: 有哪个地方是你愿意马上再去一次的？

text.en: What is your favorite travel memory involving food?
text.zh: 你最喜欢的一段与美食有关的旅行回忆是什么？

text.en: How do you spend long flights or train rides?
text.zh: 长途飞机或火车上，你通常怎样打发时间？

text.en: What is one travel mistake you learned from?
text.zh: 你从哪一次旅行失误中学到了教训？

text.en: Would you rather travel alone or with friends? Why?
text.zh: 你更愿意独自旅行还是和朋友一起？为什么？

text.en: What kind of work gives you energy?
text.zh: 什么样的工作会让你充满干劲？

text.en: Describe a job skill you had to learn the hard way.
text.zh: 请描述一项你吃过苦才学会的工作技能。

text.en: What makes a great teammate?
text.zh: 什么样的人算是优秀的队友？

text.en: What is the best advice you have received about work?
text.zh: 你收到过最好的工作建议是什么？

text.en: How do you handle a stressful deadline?
text.zh: 面对紧迫的截止日期，你会怎样应对？

text.en: What is one career goal you are working toward?
text.zh: 你目前正在努力实现的一个职业目标是什么？

text.en: Describe a time you solved a problem at work.
text.zh: 请描述一次你在工作中解决问题的经历。

text.en: What do you value more: stability or growth? Why?
text.zh: 你更看重稳定还是成长？为什么？

text.en: What is a work habit that helps you stay focused?
text.zh: 有什么工作习惯能帮助你保持专注？

text.en: What is something people misunderstand about your job or field?
text.zh: 别人常常误解你的工作或行业的哪一点？

text.en: What does a good manager do well?
text.zh: 一个好主管最擅长做好什么？

text.en: How do you recover from a mistake at work?
text.zh: 工作中犯错后，你通常怎样调整回来？

text.en: What is one skill every professional should practice?
text.zh: 每位职场人士都应该练习的一项技能是什么？

text.en: What qualities do you value most in a friend?
text.zh: 你最看重朋友的哪些品质？

text.en: How do you usually make new friends?
text.zh: 你通常怎样认识新朋友？

text.en: Describe a friendship that changed you.
text.zh: 请描述一段改变了你的友情。

text.en: What is a simple way you show appreciation to friends?
text.zh: 你会用什么简单方式向朋友表达感谢？

text.en: How do you maintain friendships when life gets busy?
text.zh: 生活忙起来时，你怎样维持友情？

text.en: What is the funniest thing a friend has said to you?
text.zh: 朋友对你说过最好笑的一句话是什么？

text.en: What makes group friendships different from one-on-one friendships?
text.zh: 群体友情和一对一的友情有什么不同？

text.en: Describe a time a friend helped you unexpectedly.
text.zh: 请描述一次朋友出乎意料帮助你的经历。

text.en: What is one activity you enjoy doing with friends?
text.zh: 你喜欢和朋友一起做的一项活动是什么？

text.en: How do you handle disagreements with friends?
text.zh: 和朋友意见不合时，你通常怎样处理？

text.en: What kind of friend are you during hard times?
text.zh: 在困难时期，你通常是什么样的朋友？

text.en: What is a memorable trip or outing with friends?
text.zh: 和朋友一起最难忘的一次出游是什么？

text.en: How has friendship changed as you got older?
text.zh: 随着年龄增长，你对友情的看法有什么变化？

text.en: What healthy habit has been easiest for you to maintain?
text.zh: 哪一种健康习惯对你来说最容易坚持？

text.en: How do you stay motivated to exercise?
text.zh: 你怎样让自己保持运动动力？

text.en: What kind of physical activity do you enjoy most?
text.zh: 你最喜欢哪一种身体活动？

text.en: What is one change that improved your energy level?
text.zh: 哪一个改变提升了你的精神状态？

text.en: How do you manage stress in a healthy way?
text.zh: 你会怎样用健康的方式管理压力？

text.en: Do you prefer exercising alone or with others? Why?
text.zh: 你更喜欢一个人运动还是和别人一起？为什么？

text.en: What is your biggest challenge in staying healthy?
text.zh: 你在保持健康方面最大的挑战是什么？

text.en: Describe a fitness goal you achieved or want to achieve.
text.zh: 请描述一个你已经完成或想完成的健身目标。

text.en: What role does sleep play in your daily life?
text.zh: 睡眠在你的日常生活中扮演什么角色？

text.en: What is one health myth you used to believe?
text.zh: 你以前相信过哪一个健康迷思？

text.en: How do you reset after an unhealthy week?
text.zh: 经历不太健康的一周后，你会怎样重新调整？

text.en: What makes a workout enjoyable for you?
text.zh: 什么会让你觉得运动很愉快？

text.en: What small step can people take to improve their health?
text.zh: 人们可以迈出哪一个小步骤来改善健康？

text.en: What meal could you eat every week and never get bored?
text.zh: 有什么食物是你每周都吃也不会腻的？

text.en: Describe a dish that reminds you of home.
text.zh: 请描述一道让你想到家的菜。

text.en: What is your favorite comfort food?
text.zh: 你最喜欢的安慰食物是什么？

text.en: Do you enjoy cooking? Why or why not?
text.zh: 你喜欢做饭吗？为什么？

text.en: What is the best meal you have had while traveling?
text.zh: 旅行时你吃过最好的一餐是什么？

text.en: What food did you dislike as a child but enjoy now?
text.zh: 小时候不喜欢、现在却喜欢上的食物是什么？

text.en: What is your go-to dish when guests visit?
text.zh: 有客人来时，你最常准备哪一道菜？

text.en: How adventurous are you with trying new foods?
text.zh: 你尝试新食物时有多大胆？

text.en: What is one snack you always keep around?
text.zh: 有什么零食是你常常会备着的？

text.en: Describe a food memory connected to a celebration.
text.zh: 请分享一个和庆祝活动有关的美食回忆。

text.en: Would you rather cook at home or eat out? Why?
text.zh: 你更喜欢在家做饭还是外食？为什么？

text.en: What is one food trend you actually like?
text.zh: 有哪一种饮食潮流是你真的喜欢的？

text.en: What makes a restaurant experience memorable for you?
text.zh: 什么会让你觉得一次餐厅体验难忘？

text.en: What app do you use the most and why?
text.zh: 你最常用哪一个应用程序？为什么？

text.en: What technology has improved your life the most?
text.zh: 哪一项科技最改善了你的生活？

text.en: What tech habit are you trying to reduce?
text.zh: 你正在尝试减少哪一种科技使用习惯？

text.en: How do you decide when to upgrade a device?
text.zh: 你通常如何决定什么时候升级设备？

text.en: What is one new technology you are curious about?
text.zh: 你对哪一种新科技感到好奇？

text.en: Do you prefer digital notes or paper notes? Why?
text.zh: 你更喜欢电子笔记还是纸本笔记？为什么？

text.en: What is your favorite tech tool for productivity?
text.zh: 你最喜欢的效率科技工具是什么？

text.en: How do you protect your privacy online?
text.zh: 你如何保护自己的网络隐私？

text.en: What is one tech frustration you deal with often?
text.zh: 你经常遇到的一项科技烦恼是什么？

text.en: Describe a time technology saved you time.
text.zh: 请描述一次科技帮你节省时间的经历。

text.en: What is a skill everyone should learn about technology?
text.zh: 每个人都该学会的一项科技技能是什么？

text.en: How do you balance screen time with offline life?
text.zh: 你怎样平衡屏幕时间和线下生活？

text.en: What invention do you wish existed already?
text.zh: 你希望现在就已经存在的发明是什么？

text.en: What is one money habit you are glad you learned?
text.zh: 你庆幸自己学会了哪一个理财习惯？

text.en: How do you decide between saving and spending?
text.zh: 你如何在存钱和花钱之间做决定？

text.en: What does financial success mean to you?
text.zh: 对你来说，财务成功意味着什么？

text.en: What is a purchase you made that was worth it?
text.zh: 你买过什么东西，让你觉得非常值得？

text.en: What is one thing you wish people learned earlier about money?
text.zh: 你希望人们更早学会哪一项金钱观念？

text.en: How do you plan for unexpected expenses?
text.zh: 面对突发开支时，你会怎样规划？

text.en: What is a small expense that adds up quickly?
text.zh: 有什么小开销会很快累积成大金额？

text.en: Do you budget regularly? Why or why not?
text.zh: 你有固定做预算吗？为什么？

text.en: What is a smart purchase you made recently?
text.zh: 你最近做过哪一笔聪明的消费？

text.en: What financial goal are you currently focused on?
text.zh: 你目前专注的财务目标是什么？

text.en: How do you avoid impulse buying?
text.zh: 你怎样避免冲动消费？

text.en: What is one thing you spend on without regret?
text.zh: 有什么花费是你完全不会后悔的？

text.en: What subject did you enjoy most in school?
text.zh: 你在学校最喜欢哪一门科目？

text.en: What is one skill you taught yourself?
text.zh: 有什么技能是你自己学会的？

text.en: How do you learn best: reading, watching, or doing?
text.zh: 你最适合怎样学习：阅读、观看还是动手实践？

text.en: Describe a teacher who influenced you.
text.zh: 请描述一位影响过你的老师。

text.en: What is something you are interested in learning now?
text.zh: 你现在有兴趣学习什么？

text.en: What is a lesson from school that you still use today?
text.zh: 学校里学到的哪一课，你至今仍在使用？

text.en: How do you stay curious as an adult?
text.zh: 成年后，你怎样保持好奇心？

text.en: What makes learning difficult for you sometimes?
text.zh: 有时候什么会让学习变得困难？

text.en: What is a book or course that taught you a lot?
text.zh: 哪一本书或哪一门课程让你学到很多？

text.en: Do you prefer structured classes or self-paced learning? Why?
text.zh: 你更喜欢有结构的课程还是自主学习？为什么？

text.en: What is one thing schools should teach more of?
text.zh: 学校应该多教一点什么？

text.en: Describe a time you failed and learned from it.
text.zh: 请描述一次你失败后学到东西的经历。

text.en: What hobby helps you forget about time?
text.zh: 什么爱好会让你忘记时间？

text.en: How did you get started with your favorite hobby?
text.zh: 你是怎样开始自己最喜欢的爱好的？

text.en: What hobby would you like to try next?
text.zh: 接下来你想尝试什么爱好？

text.en: What hobby did you enjoy as a child?
text.zh: 小时候你喜欢什么爱好？

text.en: Do you prefer creative hobbies or active hobbies? Why?
text.zh: 你更喜欢创意型爱好还是活动型爱好？为什么？

text.en: What hobby has helped you meet new people?
text.zh: 哪一种爱好帮你认识了新朋友？

text.en: What is challenging about keeping a hobby long term?
text.zh: 长期坚持一个爱好最大的挑战是什么？

text.en: How do you make time for hobbies during busy weeks?
text.zh: 忙碌的时候，你怎样为爱好腾出时间？

text.en: What hobby skill are you currently improving?
text.zh: 你目前正在提升哪一项爱好技能？

text.en: What hobby would you recommend to beginners?
text.zh: 你会向初学者推荐什么爱好？

text.en: Describe a project you completed for fun.
text.zh: 请描述一个你为了好玩而完成的小项目。

text.en: Have your hobbies changed over the years? How?
text.zh: 这些年来你的爱好有变化吗？怎么变的？

text.en: What makes someone a leader in everyday life?
text.zh: 在日常生活中，什么样的人算是领导者？

text.en: Describe a leader you admire and why.
text.zh: 请描述一位你敬佩的领导者，并说明原因。

text.en: How do you build trust in a team?
text.zh: 你怎样在团队中建立信任？

text.en: What is harder: leading friends or strangers? Why?
text.zh: 带领朋友和带领陌生人，哪个更难？为什么？

text.en: How do you make decisions when information is incomplete?
text.zh: 当信息不完整时，你如何做决定？

text.en: What should leaders do when they make mistakes?
text.zh: 领导者犯错时应该怎么做？

text.en: How do you motivate people without pressure?
text.zh: 你怎样在不给压力的情况下激励别人？

text.en: What is one leadership skill you want to improve?
text.zh: 你想提升的一项领导力技能是什么？

text.en: Describe a time you took initiative.
text.zh: 请描述一次你主动承担责任的经历。

text.en: How do you handle conflict as a leader?
text.zh: 作为领导者，你如何处理冲突？

text.en: What is the difference between leadership and authority?
text.zh: 领导力和权威有什么不同？

text.en: When should a leader listen more than speak?
text.zh: 领导者应该在什么时候多听少说？

text.en: What makes someone a good listener?
text.zh: 什么样的人算是好的倾听者？

text.en: How do you handle misunderstandings in conversation?
text.zh: 谈话中出现误会时，你会怎样处理？

text.en: What is one communication habit you are improving?
text.zh: 你正在改进哪一个沟通习惯？

text.en: Do you prefer direct feedback or gentle feedback? Why?
text.zh: 你更喜欢直接的反馈还是温和的反馈？为什么？

text.en: How do you prepare for an important conversation?
text.zh: 重要谈话前，你会怎样准备？

text.en: What makes a presentation engaging?
text.zh: 什么会让一场演讲更吸引人？

text.en: How do you communicate differently with friends and coworkers?
text.zh: 你与朋友和同事沟通时有什么不同？

text.en: Describe a time better communication solved a problem.
text.zh: 请描述一次更好的沟通解决了问题的经历。

text.en: What is harder for you: speaking up or staying quiet?
text.zh: 对你来说，开口表达和保持沉默哪个更难？

text.en: How do you stay calm during tense discussions?
text.zh: 在紧张的讨论中，你怎样保持冷静？

text.en: What role does body language play in communication?
text.zh: 肢体语言在沟通中扮演什么角色？

text.en: How do you know when someone really understands you?
text.zh: 你如何判断对方真的理解了你？

text.en: What value is most important in your daily decisions?
text.zh: 在日常决定中，你最重视哪一种价值观？

text.en: How do your values influence your friendships?
text.zh: 你的价值观怎样影响你的友情？

text.en: What value did your family teach you strongly?
text.zh: 你的家庭最强调哪一种价值观？

text.en: Describe a time you had to choose between convenience and principle.
text.zh: 请描述一次你必须在方便和原则之间做选择的经历。

text.en: What does integrity mean to you?
text.zh: 对你来说，正直意味着什么？

text.en: How do you respond when others disagree with your values?
text.zh: 当别人不同意你的价值观时，你会怎样回应？

text.en: What value do you think society needs more of?
text.zh: 你觉得社会更需要哪一种价值观？

text.en: How have your values changed over time?
text.zh: 这些年来，你的价值观有什么变化？

text.en: What value is easy to talk about but hard to practice?
text.zh: 哪一种价值观说起来容易，做起来却难？

text.en: How do you teach values to children or younger people?
text.zh: 你会怎样把价值观传递给孩子或年轻人？

text.en: What does respect look like in everyday behavior?
text.zh: 尊重在日常行为中应该是什么样子？

text.en: Why is honesty sometimes difficult?
text.zh: 为什么诚实有时候会很难？

text.en: What part of your culture are you most proud of?
text.zh: 你对自己文化中的哪一部分最感到自豪？

text.en: How do traditions shape identity?
text.zh: 传统如何塑造一个人的身份认同？

text.en: What is a cultural celebration you enjoy?
text.zh: 你喜欢的文化庆典是什么？

text.en: Describe a cultural difference that taught you something.
text.zh: 请描述一个让你学到东西的文化差异。

text.en: How does food help people understand culture?
text.zh: 食物如何帮助人们理解一种文化？

text.en: What is one tradition you want to preserve?
text.zh: 你想保留哪一项传统？

text.en: How do movies or music influence cultural understanding?
text.zh: 电影或音乐怎样影响人们对文化的理解？

text.en: What cultural custom from another place do you admire?
text.zh: 你欣赏其他地方的哪一种文化习俗？

text.en: How has culture changed in your community over time?
text.zh: 你所在社区的文化这些年来有什么变化？

text.en: What does cultural respect mean in practice?
text.zh: 真正做到文化尊重，具体表现是什么？

text.en: How can people stay curious about other cultures?
text.zh: 人们怎样保持对其他文化的好奇心？

text.en: Describe a time you felt welcomed in a different culture.
text.zh: 请描述一次你在不同文化中感到被欢迎的经历。

text.en: What kind of humor makes you laugh the most?
text.zh: 什么样的幽默最能让你发笑？

text.en: Describe a harmless prank or funny moment you remember.
text.zh: 请描述一个无伤大雅的恶作剧或好笑时刻。

text.en: Who is the funniest person you know and why?
text.zh: 你认识的人里谁最幽默？为什么？

text.en: What is a silly habit you have that others notice?
text.zh: 你有什么别人会注意到的小怪习惯？

text.en: What movie or show always cheers you up?
text.zh: 哪一部电影或节目总能让你心情变好？

text.en: What is the best joke you have heard recently?
text.zh: 你最近听过最有趣的笑话是什么？

text.en: When is humor helpful in daily life?
text.zh: 在日常生活中，幽默什么时候最有帮助？

text.en: How do you react when something embarrassing becomes funny later?
text.zh: 一件尴尬的事后来变得好笑时，你通常会怎么想？

text.en: What is a funny misunderstanding you still remember?
text.zh: 你还记得哪一次好笑的误会？

text.en: Do you prefer clever humor or simple humor? Why?
text.zh: 你更喜欢机智型幽默还是简单型幽默？为什么？

text.en: What everyday situation could use a little more humor?
text.zh: 日常生活中，哪一种情况最需要多一点幽默？

text.en: What is a lighthearted memory that always makes you smile?
text.zh: 有什么轻松愉快的回忆总会让你微笑？
